name: bound-inclusion-unit-native
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun lean-kernel/lift-special/export-source-fixture.ts "$OUT/current-toy-source.json" > "$OUT/source-fixture.log"; status=0; bunx tsc -p lean-kernel/lift-special/tsconfig.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1 || status=$?; BOUND_INCLUSION_TINY="$OUT/project" bun test lean-kernel/lift-special/bound-inclusion.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; rm -rf .lake; exit $status

name: structural-weakening-native
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun lean-kernel/lift-special/prepare-helper.ts "$OUT/project"; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean StructuralWeakening.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; rm -rf .lake
